name: puppet-intro-verbatim
js: document.querySelector('#panel .pinocchio').textContent.includes('A puppet, an iphone, a polaroid. A puppet, an iphone, a polaroid. A puppet, an iphone... are you getting it? These are not three separate things. This is one thing, and we are calling it an insanely great product.')

name: hand-clearance
js: (function(){ const c = window.__puppet.clearance(); return c.phone > 0.001 && c.camera > 0.001; })()

(function(){ const p = window.__puppet.point('phone'); document.getElementById('scene').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y, bubbles: true, pointerType: 'mouse' })); })()

(function(){ const p = window.__puppet.point('camera'); document.getElementById('scene').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y, bubbles: true, pointerType: 'mouse' })); })()

(function(){ const p = window.__puppet.point('puppet'); document.getElementById('scene').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y, bubbles: true, pointerType: 'mouse' })); })()

(function(){ const p = window.__puppet.point('camera'); const c = document.getElementById('scene'); const o = { clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y, bubbles: true }; c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', o)); })()

(function(){ const p = window.__puppet.point('phone'); const c = document.getElementById('scene'); const o = { clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y, bubbles: true }; c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', o)); })()

(function(){ const p = window.__puppet.point('puppet'); const c = document.getElementById('scene'); const o = { clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y, bubbles: true }; c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', o)); })()
